## Prompt submission

Complete this checklist before requesting review.

- [ ] I used the standard prompt record format.
- [ ] The title, use case, prompt text, required inputs, output, next steps, demo decision, and contact fields are complete.
- [ ] I tested the prompt with representative, approved content.
- [ ] I removed customer data, credentials, personal data, and non-public source content.
- [ ] I added accurate category and tags.

## Review notes

Explain the value of this prompt and any limits reviewers should consider.
